description:
“It’s okay if I don’t shine, I will make my team to become the main character after winning the game.”

Lee Jae-hyeok, disappointed at the appearance of the volleyball team he faced at the same time as entering high school, "Is this the volleyball club..?"  
Jae-hyeok decides to form a team with Do Min-hwan, who has been with him since childhood, and Kim Dan-woo, who has grown tired of the volleyball club's bad behavior.  
Individual team members begin to gather one by one, and different friends gather  
run toward one goal. The goal is top notch!!

[Pre-serialization](https://comic.naver.com/bestChallenge/list?titleId=792314)
